title: Astra is cool, but so hard to make animations. Here are some I have made.
author: xcantene
selftext:
Yeah, I have been using Claude Fable and am now working with Astra in VS Code. 

It is nice. I would say better than Fable. But holy cow, how fast those credits burn is crazy to me. 

Still trying to figure out how to even prompt some of these animations properly. I have to give details, and in a 3d environment is quite complex. In my VFX Studio, I made it work for a 2d environment where I can set up keyframes just like a normal video tool, and it auto generates me the code that I need. Now that I am messing with a 3D environment for my mobile version of my game is where things start to get complex. 

Anyways, do you guys feel this is okay/convincing enough? I am just trying to make a proof of concept game in hope to get some backers.
